assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: side-on FOOD TRUCK sprite for an animated Playdate intro, 5:3 landscape, 1600x960 if possible.
Create one large complete American-style step-van BURGER FOOD TRUCK, viewed exactly from its passenger/service side, orthographic side elevation with the cab facing RIGHT. Black ink on pure white. Long rectangular boxy cargo body on the left; short boxy cab at right with slanted windshield; exactly two road wheels visible in side profile. Simple solid dark tires and small white hubs, bold chassis and bumper, modest roof vent. Vehicle entirely visible with generous white margins. No perspective view and no front-facing grille.
The side cargo body must have one very large clean rectangular service shutter occupying most of the body side, horizontal 5:3 proportions, centered in the left cargo section, with plain white flat interior and a simple strong black border. This region is a compositing opening: DO NOT draw graffiti, slats, text or a logo inside it. Keep it geometrically rectangular with four straight edges, no perspective distortion. No awning projecting over it. This blank service shutter will be replaced by the existing menu art shown in the reference.
Scale/framing: the complete van spans about x5%-96% and y20%-83% of the canvas. Wheels touch a shared baseline around y83%. Blank service rectangle roughly x12%-65%, y27%-66%. The main graphic must read clearly when the whole canvas is reduced to 360x216.
Style: coarse black-and-white 1-bit newspaper / Playdate ink illustration, black contour lines, white painted vehicle panels, sparse halftone material shading, a few paint scuffs. Less texture than the reference graffiti so the vehicle silhouette remains clear. No grayscale gradient, no color, no glossy 3D.
PURE WHITE background everywhere outside the vehicle. No road, ground stripe, speed strokes, scenery, buildings, palm trees, people or driver. No cast shadow touching the background, no labels or menu UI. No text at all, no branding, no watermark.
Reference image is only for matching the black/white linework and texture; do not copy its graffiti onto the truck because that will be overlaid as an independent layer later.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the attached side-view black-and-white food truck.
Change ONLY the service hatch opening on the LEFT cargo body. The current rectangle is too wide and short. Replace it with a narrower, TALLER rectangular service shutter frame with exact WIDTH:HEIGHT ratio 5:3, matching a landscape game display. Its interior remains completely plain white with no slats, no lettering, no graffiti.
On this approximately 1619x971 image place the new inner opening at approximately x=320, y=250, width=630, height=378, ending x=950,y=628. Keep all four edges straight and orthographic, with a narrow dark metal frame. Restore the areas of old opening outside this new rectangle to normal light white truck body sheet metal with restrained scuffs.
Preserve everything else: the full truck side elevation, position, scale, cab facing right, wheels, chassis, vent, black-white coarse ink texture, and pure white background. Do not add any words, other windows or decoration. The opening must visibly have 5:3 proportions, NOT a panoramic letterbox. Keep the full image landscape 5:3 and the entire van inside the canvas.
